$comment: S-103: the App Privacy (App Store Connect) and Data safety (Google Play) answers for the consumer app, entered by hand in each console (neither has an API for them). Keep equal to the privacy manifest in app.config.ts — the release check compares them. docs/runbooks/mobile-release.md § Privacy answers.

serviceProviders.name: Stripe
serviceProviders.why: Card payments: the card is entered in Stripe's payment sheet and goes to Stripe, never to Northline (processor acting for Northline, not sharing).

serviceProviders.name: Apple Push Notification service, Firebase Cloud Messaging
serviceProviders.why: Delivering notifications: the push token, the words, a link and ids — no name, email, phone or address (docs/runbooks/push.md).

serviceProviders.name: Stripe Identity
serviceProviders.why: 2026-10-04: the one-time age check before buying alcohol. The customer photographs a government photo ID and takes a selfie in Stripe's hosted page, opened in the in-app browser. The photos, the ID details and the face match stay with Stripe (processor acting for Northline; the session is redacted once the age is known); Northline receives and keeps only 'verified over N, on date, by method'.

accountDeletion.status: S-105: You › Personal details › Your data › Delete my account (a privacy request confirmed with the texted code or the authenticator app; the account closes when the grace period ends); the web link is the consumer site's same page

Name.why: The account (Create account) and the name on orders and bookings.

EmailAddress.why: The account; receipts and order emails.

PhoneNumber.why: Sign-in codes by SMS or call; the courier or provider can reach the customer about a delivery or visit.

PhysicalAddress.why: The delivery address and where a service visit happens.

PreciseLocation.why: Only after "Use my location" and only while the app is open: suggests the delivery address and shows what serves it. Never shared with businesses.

UserID.why: The Northline account id behind every signed-in call.

DeviceID.why: The push token and a random installation id (never a hardware id), only when notifications are allowed (PUT /me/devices).

PurchaseHistory.why: Orders, bookings, quotes and refunds on the account.

PaymentInfo.why: Collected by Stripe's SDK in the app's payment sheet; Northline keeps the card brand and last 4 only.

CustomerSupport.why: What the customer writes when reporting a problem with an order or booking.

OtherUserContent.why: Notes on a booking or quote request (the vehicle, access instructions) sent to the business.

PhotosorVideos.why: Only the photos the customer chooses: up to 3 on a problem report (camera or photo picker, sent to Northline support and the business on the case), and a pilot participant's screenshot on feedback. No photo library access beyond the picked image.

OtherDataTypes.why: 2026-10-04: the age check's result, only for a customer who buys alcohol: verified over N (N capped at the strictest legal age), the date and the method. Never the ID, its number, the photos or the date of birth.

notCollected: Search history (queries are answered, not kept)
Crash or performance data (no crash reporter in the app yet)
Coarse location beyond the precise location above
